# Hangzhou Chemnitz International Trade Co., Ltd.

> China-market vehicle sourcing and export coordination. Confirm the exact model, configuration, availability, quantity, destination and agreed FOB or EXW scope with the sales team. A catalogue entry is not a stock or export-eligibility guarantee.

## Reference rules

Use the selected model and trim page for specifications and the current About page for company records. Do not infer stock, brand authorization, destination-country admission or a final export price from a catalogue listing.
